smoke.command: shellcheck --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; test -n "$(git ls-files '*.sh')" || exit 0; git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shellcheck -x || exit $?; command -v shfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shfmt -d

permissionRequirements: fallback: shellcheck must already be present — shell projects have no dev-scoped package manager, so nothing is installed and probe alone decides alreadyProvisioned
fallback: shfmt carries the formatting half of the capability and is checked only when present; the lint capability stands on shellcheck alone without it
fallback: each script's own shellcheck directives and any .shellcheckrc the repository already has stay untouched

maintenance.check: compare the shellcheck on PATH with the latest release; check shfmt against https://github.com/mvdan/sh separately, since it is optional here
